content: The fictional BrightWash unit-dose capsule uses an opaque, child-resistant outer pack, qualified film, prominent warnings and safe-storage instructions. The design review checks ASTM F3159 and applicable EU CLP and detergent obligations. Bittering or other mitigations supplement, but never replace, secure closure and caregiver guidance.
title: Unit-dose child-safety controls

content: Under China's CSAR framework, a team first classifies a cosmetic as special or general. The resulting NMPA registration or notification package may require formula, product standards, safety assessment, efficacy support and manufacturing evidence. Market status and current transition rules are verified before launch.
title: China cosmetic registration decision

content: Every synthetic product claim must be truthful, non-misleading and supported before release. The claim owner records wording, market, audience, comparator and evidence. Numeric, clinical or superiority language receives heightened Legal and technical review, and approved copy cannot broaden the tested condition or population.
title: Claim substantiation control

content: EU Regulation (EC) 1223/2009 requires a Responsible Person, Product Information File, Cosmetic Product Safety Report, CPNP notification and GMP alignment such as ISO 22716 before an EU cosmetic is placed on the market. Formula and labeling checks cover the applicable annexes, including prohibited or restricted substances, preservatives, colorants and UV filters.
title: EU cosmetic market-entry checklist

content: Fictional SmileBright anticavity paste, ScalpShield antidandruff shampoo and regulated antiperspirant or sunscreen concepts require product-class review under the current US OTC monograph framework. The dossier verifies permitted actives, concentration, testing and Drug Facts labeling. A non-monograph active or claim follows the applicable approval route.
title: US OTC monograph classification

content: EU fragrance-allergen assessment uses the formula level, supplier declarations and whether the product is leave-on or rinse-off. Named allergens above applicable thresholds appear in labeling, with Regulation (EU) 2023/1545 transition timing tracked by market. Change control reruns the calculation after perfume or dose changes.
title: Fragrance allergen label control

content: The synthetic ingredient portal publishes approved ingredient names from controlled formula and supplier records. Regulatory staff reconcile INCI or required market nomenclature, fragrance and preservative disclosures, and effective dates. A public record is blocked when the supplier declaration, formula version or label version disagrees.
title: Ingredient disclosure reconciliation

content: A water-based product receives a preservation strategy based on formula, package and use. ISO 11930 challenge testing or a justified equivalent verifies control over the intended life. Preservatives must satisfy applicable positive lists such as EU Annex V, while a self-preserving claim requires evidence rather than ingredient absence alone.
title: Preservation and challenge-test standard

content: Post-market surveillance combines complaints, adverse events and serious undesirable effects where EU 1223/2009 applies. Trained reviewers assess seriousness, expectedness, product identity and lot pattern. A signal may trigger sample review, investigation, reporting, label change or corrective action, with each decision retained.
title: Post-market safety signal process

content: An out-of-specification result opens a deviation and quarantines affected material or product. The team confirms data integrity, bounds the impact and performs root-cause analysis using evidence such as batch records, 5-Whys or fishbone. CAPA owners define corrective and preventive actions, and effectiveness is verified before closure under applicable GMP.
title: Deviation quarantine and CAPA

content: REACH Regulation (EC) 1907/2006 controls EU substance registration and certain authorization or restriction duties. The synthetic sourcing check records supplier registration coverage, use, tonnage context and Annex XVII restrictions. Substances of Very High Concern receive an explicit authorization and communication review.
title: EU REACH sourcing check

content: The synthetic safety assessment identifies ingredient hazard, estimates exposure for the intended use and compares exposure with a point of departure such as a NOAEL to calculate margin of safety. Aggregate exposure and vulnerable users are considered where relevant. Data gaps may use justified read-across, in-silico or in-vitro new-approach methods, followed by independent review.
title: Exposure-based product safety assessment
